validation.newTestName: real Forecast verifier refuses a false total, an out-of-schema operation and an invented source while preserving Planner and C08

scope: False-total body reaches actual Planner replay comparison.
Closed schema rejects the extra operation.
Resealed invented record ref is structurally valid but lacks source authority and is checked by real BCS.
Published-model branch alone uses a real native envelope; private malformed publisher attempt remains unobserved.

review: The driver uses the actual mounted HTTP input producer, real issued Planner references, real C08 case and createSfForecastVerifier over the actual BusinessServices. Both predicate scopes use an authenticated human admission with business.withCase; grants include all requested UI operations and default analysis.prepare/read/start/cancel actions.

A single USD forecast row across 12 months gives confirmed components with annual sums590000 and596000, January50000 and56000 and known difference6000. The separate monthly outlook value is selected by its :1:outlook suffix rather than the line :outlook-usd value. Without a classified C10 basis, comparison remains conditioned and completeDifference null.

The false numeric value and re-sealed but unissued source remain structurally admissible shapes and must fail the real semantic predicate. The operation property is outside the closed FinancialAnalysis schema and must also fail the semantic digest comparison. Source resolution independently refuses an authorized projection for the invented selector.

The Reflect.apply call deliberately bypasses only the static full-envelope parameter type to probe a body-level predicate that consumes kind,payload,evidenceRefs. No runtime admission, Session, provenance, receipt or output identity is synthesized for this branch; emitted evidence explicitly says envelopeAdmissionExecuted=false and malformedPublicationAttemptExecuted=false.

When an installed model exists, executeWp12NativeMission requires a real ready envelope and receipt. Negative candidates clone that actual envelope, preserve run provenance and re-seal the changed body. The genuine output remains in C08 and is read after reopening. This is still a semantic recheck, not an adversarial completion entering the private publisher.

After each attack, Planner replay must match the normalized real comparison, the raw Planner state and case must stay unchanged, and C08 contribution/native-run content must remain unchanged. A fresh host reopens the same store and repeats domain/persisted-state assertions.

No concrete TypeScript union/narrowing, handler export, authority, monthly-ID or request-shape mismatch was found in the reviewed source. The exact payload type remains FinancialAnalysis, and schema-incompatible additions are intentionally adversarial body data.
limits: Static review does not establish hosted typecheck or product success.
Four or more real verifier reads and Planner replays may be expensive; the explicit420000ms deadline is unchanged and runtime duration remains to be observed.

The installed publisher has no external candidate submission port. This test must not be recorded as rejection of a malicious native completion by the private publication path or as full GNATIVE closure.
No model catalog, provider configuration, credential, native receipt or grant is fabricated.

scope_precision: c08Unchanged observes selected case and contributions/nativeRuns only. It is not a claim about every namespace or storageVersion.
